How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NHM Kerala Chief Engineer Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 21-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NHM Kerala to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NHM Kerala Chief Engineer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Chief Engineer position at NHM Kerala is 21st August 2026. It is advisable to complete the application process well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the Chief Engineer post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Chief Engineer post, candidates must hold a Graduate degree in Civil Engineering. Additionally, they should have significant experience as detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Chief Engineer position is 59 years. Candidates should ensure they meet this age criterion before proceeding with their application.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Chief Engineer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the post of Chief Engineer in the National Health Mission Kerala recruitment drive for 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the NHM Kerala Chief Engineer role?
faq.answer: The application fee for both General/OBC and SC/ST categories is Rs. 250/-. This fee needs to be paid online as part of the application process.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Chief Engineer position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Chief Engineer post will primarily involve an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience for this stage.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent or contract job?
faq.answer: The job type for the Chief Engineer position is on a contract basis. Candidates should be aware of this employment term before applying.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the Important Links section provided. It is highly recommended to read the notification thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary structure for the Chief Engineer post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Chief Engineer position will be determined based on Government decisions. Specific details regarding the salary will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of NHM Kerala?
faq.answer: The official website of the National Health Mission Kerala is www.arogyakeralam.gov.in. You can visit this site for more information and updates regarding their recruitments.
